frames.narration: Two shapes and two visitors. The shapes know nothing about area or perimeter.
The client asks the circle to accept the area visitor.
First half of double dispatch: the circle knows it is a circle, so it calls the visitor's circle method.
Second half: the visitor knows which operation it is. Circle + area gives pi r squared.
Now a rectangle with the same visitor. A different shape selects a different visit method.
A new operation: the perimeter visitor. The shapes are not edited at all.
Each operation lives in one class. Adding 'describe' or 'export to JSON' later is one more visitor.
